title: Optimizable Model Averaging for Ensembling Heterogeneous Model Outputs
abstract: arXiv:2505.21857v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Foundation model ensembles can improve accuracy and robustness, but full fine-tuning and parameter-space merging are often expensive or impossible when candidate models have different architectures. We propose Optimizable Model Averaging (OMA), a black-box approach that learns nonnegative model-combination weights, one scalar coefficient per model, to average the candidate models' predictive probabilities, leaving all model parameters frozen, by minimizing regularized predictive entropy. A central challenge is that minimizing predictive entropy can favour confidently incorrect models: increased confidence need not imply improved accuracy or calibration. We therefore examine regularization as a mechanism for controlling adaptation and empirically evaluate its effect on calibration, observing lower expected calibration error in selected configurations, alongside better performance-calibration trade-offs than model output averaging. translated_title: 用于集成异构模型输出的可优化模型平均方法
translated_abstract: 基础模型集成可以提高准确性和鲁棒性，但当候选模型具有不同的架构时，完全微调和参数空间合并通常代价高昂甚至无法实现。我们提出了可优化模型平均（OMA），这是一种黑盒方法，它通过学习非负的模型组合权重（每个模型对应一个标量系数）来平均候选模型的预测概率，同时保持所有模型参数冻结，并通过最小化正则化预测熵来实现。一个核心挑战是最小化预测熵可能偏向那些过度自信但错误的模型：置信度的提升并不必然意味着准确性或校准的改善。因此，我们研究了正则化作为控制适应性的一种机制，并通过实验评估了其对校准的影响，观察到在选定配置中期望校准误差更低，同时相比模型输出平均方法具有更好的性能-校准权衡。
tldr: 提出可优化模型平均（OMA），一种黑盒集成方法，通过最小化正则化预测熵来学习非负组合权重以融合异构架构模型的预测概率，无需微调或参数合并即可改善性能与校准。
en_tdlr: We propose Optimizable Model Averaging (OMA), a black-box ensemble method that learns nonnegative combination weights by minimizing regularized predictive entropy to average predictions from heterogeneous models, improving performance and calibration without fine-tuning or parameter merging.
